title: A Rubik's cube has 43 quintillion positions
body: Counting reachable arrangements, permuting corners and edges minus illegal twists, gives 43,252,003,274,489,856,000 positions. Yet God's number, proved in 2010 with massive computation, is 20: any scramble is at most twenty moves from solved. The state space is oceanic, the diameter strangely walkable.
source_hint: Rokicki et al., God's number proof (2010)
